pages.text: Binding the rods of a Breeze around an animated core produces a focus that calls forth a $(l:goety:summons/breeze_servants)Breeze Servant$(): a living gust that leaps and slides around your enemies, pelting them with wind charges. Potency strengthens each summoned Breeze, adding damage and knockback to its wind charges for every level.
Casting with the $(l:crafts/staff/wind_staff)Wind Staff$() summons two Breezes at once.
